word_family.gloss: 多位女王；多个后棋或Q牌

senses.zh_definition: 女王；王后。前者本人为君主，后者为国王的配偶。

senses.ms_definition: Ratu yang memerintah sesebuah negara, atau permaisuri kepada seorang raja.

senses.en_definition: The chess piece that moves any unobstructed distance horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
senses.ms_definition: Buah catur yang boleh bergerak sejauh mana-mana petak yang tidak terhalang secara mendatar, menegak atau menyerong.
senses.nuances: 英语棋语，标准马来语通常称 menteri。后并非王，失后不等于立即输棋。[Collins：queen](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/queen)

senses.ms_definition: Dalam slanga Inggeris, panggilan pujian kepada seseorang; dalam konteks lain, sebutan terhadap lelaki gay yang boleh menyinggung perasaan.
senses.nuances: 赞美用法与带贬义的旧用法须依关系、语气和社群判断，不能据此推断性取向。[Cambridge：queen](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/queen)

etymology.historical_story: Queen descends from Old English cwēn, whose meanings included woman, wife, and queen. Its history therefore reaches beyond royal office into older vocabulary for women and marriage. Modern English also applies the word to chess pieces and reproductive insects. In Malay conversation, these English uses must be distinguished from established Malay equivalents. [Merriam-Webster：queen](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/queen)

etymology.historical_story: Quinn is recorded among the English forms of the Irish surname Ó Cuinn, meaning descendant of Conn. The historical relationship belongs to Irish naming traditions, rather than Malay word formation. When Quinn appears in a Malay sentence, the name is normally retained as a whole; its older components do not function as Malay affixes. [Source](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/oc/o-cuinn.php)

etymology.historical_story: English quill has a Middle English history associated with a hollow stalk or tube; its deeper origin is uncertain. Its familiar writing sense reflects the use of prepared feathers as pens. The word also names an animal's sharp spine, linking objects through their stiff, pointed shape. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/quill).

etymology.historical_story: Quentin reached modern usage through French from Latin Quintinus, related to Quintus and the Latin word for fifth. Its history preserves a connection between personal names and numbers. That connection explains the name’s origin, but does not determine a modern bearer’s birth order, personality, nationality, or gender. In Malay sentences, it functions simply as a personal name. Source: [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/quentin).

etymology.historical_story: Qi represents the Chinese term 气, traditionally written 氣, associated with vital force in Chinese medicine. etymology.historical_story: The letter q belongs to the Roman alphabet adopted for writing Malay in Rumi. Its ancestry extends through earlier Mediterranean alphabets to the Semitic letter qoph. In Malay, it is a writing symbol rather than an ordinary vocabulary root, so words beginning with q do not form its morphological family. See [Q](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Q).

senses.nuances: 这是有文献支持的音乐术语释义，但尚不能确认它就是输入词条所指的意思，也未核实为 DBP 正式马来语义项。此处的马来语定义为编写释义。首次出现宜补充 guqin 或 alat muzik petik tradisional Cina。不要与指秦朝、姓氏或人名的 Qin 混同，也不要把所有含 qin 的中国乐器名称都理解为古琴。[词义依据：The Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Qin](https://www.metmuseum.org/fr/essays/the-qin)。

etymology.historical_story: Qin is the pinyin spelling of Chinese 琴, the name used for the classical instrument also called guqin. Its restrained sound became associated with scholarly cultivation and intimate listening. UNESCO describes guqin playing as one of the traditional arts expected of Chinese scholars. This cultural history does not establish when qin entered Malay usage. [Source: UNESCO, Guqin and its music](https://ich.unesco.org/en/RL/guqin-and-its-music-00061).

etymology.historical_story: Qasim comes from Arabic qāsim, meaning someone who divides or distributes. It was also the name of a son of the Prophet Muhammad. The name belongs to a wider Muslim naming tradition rather than to Malay productive word formation. Spellings such as Kasim and Kassim reflect different transliteration conventions. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/qasim)

etymology.historical_story: In the martial-arts interpretation, qiang represents Chinese 枪／槍, written qiāng in Mandarin pinyin. Malay-language descriptions of wushu sometimes retain this Chinese equipment name alongside a Malay explanation such as lembing. This documents its use in a specialist setting, but does not establish when it entered Malay or whether the supplied database token refers to that weapon. messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak terjemah «queens» ni. Maksudnya ratu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak menterjemahkan perkataan «queens» ini. Adakah maksudnya beberapa orang ratu?
messages.zh: 我想翻译这个 queens，是指几位女王吗？
messages.en: I'm trying to translate queens here. Does it mean several female monarchs?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tengok ayat penuh dulu. Hantar kat aku, nanti kita semak sama-sama.
messages.ms_standard: Lihat ayat penuhnya dahulu. Hantarkan ayat itu kepada saya supaya kita dapat menyemaknya bersama-sama.
messages.zh: 先看看完整句子。发给我，我们一起确认。
messages.en: Let's see the full sentence first. Send it to me and we'll check it together.

etymology.historical_story: English queen descends from Old English cwēn, whose meanings included woman, wife, and queen. The modern form queens adds the regular English plural ending. Its royal associations also appear in the names of chess pieces, playing cards, and reproductive insects. This history explains the English word; it does not establish an officially adopted Malay borrowing. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/queen).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: queen 是一个，queens 是多个；末尾听见 /z/，想到英语复数。先辨认外语词形，再按语境选马来语译词。

senses.zh_definition: 外语音乐术语候选义：库伊卡鼓，一种巴西摩擦鼓，通过摩擦连接鼓膜内侧的杆使其发声，并可按压鼓膜改变音高。
senses.en_definition: In foreign musical terminology, a variant name for the cuíca, a Brazilian friction drum sounded by rubbing an internal rod, with pitch varied by pressure on the drumhead.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam istilah muzik asing, nama lain bagi cuíca, iaitu gendang geseran Brazil yang dibunyikan dengan menggesek batang di bahagian dalamnya; pic diubah dengan menekan membran.
senses.nuances: 这是外语术语候选义，并非已核实的 DBP 官方马来语释义。美国国会图书馆列有 quica 与 cuíca 的名称对应关系。以下搭配与例句为该候选义的教学示例，未证实属于马来语高频用法。依据 [美国国会图书馆音乐术语表](https://www.loc.gov/aba/publications/Archived-LCMPT18/MEDIUM.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Quica is documented as an alternative instrument name for cuíca. A specimen in Islington's educational collection illustrates the mechanism: rubbing a rod attached to a skin makes the membrane vibrate. The instrument is associated with Brazilian samba. This explains the musical candidate meaning, but does not establish when, or whether, quica entered standard Malaysian Malay. [Collection source](https://www.objectlessons.org/ceremony-and-celebration-music/quica-brazil/s80/a955/)
